pages: Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy running singlet and grey shorts, runs uphill past a hairpin bend with his arms driving and his mouth open. Middle distance: one white marker post beside the road, the tussock bank, a gravel run-off. Background: grey road climbing away, high hard summer sun.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, stands bent double past the hairpin with both fists on his knees, sweat dropping off his chin onto the gravel. Middle distance: one bicycle leaning on a marker post far above, tussocks. Background: the road going on up, thin bright sky.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy running singlet and grey shorts, leans over a kitchen table holding one running shoe, arguing his own pace. Middle distance: a bowl of cereal, an open training log, a banana in a bowl. Background: a window over a deck, bright morning kitchen light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, sits on the edge of a bed in the dark holding one shin with both hands. Middle distance: a plaster cast propped against the bed leg, a school bag. Background: a window with the blind down, cold blue morning light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a white school shirt, stands in a hallway with one white leg cast and its sticker bright on the outside. Middle distance: a crutch against the wall, a pair of running shoes, a school bag. Background: an open front door, flat winter light on the step.

Coach Ria Tahiwi, a stocky woman in a black puffer jacket with a whistle on a lanyard, walks a soaked school field with one clipboard held out in the rain and a bin lid under her arm. Middle distance: a starting cone, a folded stopwatch. Background: a wet grandstand, flat grey rain light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, jogs slowly on a gravel path with one wrist turned up to look at the sports watch. Middle distance: a track hurdle, an upturned bin lid, a painted line. Background: school buildings and a grey winter sky, flat light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, stands on a running track pointing one finger down at his own shin bone. Middle distance: one lane line, a coil of hose, a spike of grass. Background: school buildings, a hedge and a low fence, flat overcast light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, sits on a track kerb holding one small finger clip against his own index finger. Middle distance: his sports watch, a water bottle, a spike of grass. Background: a running track, a fence and grey sky, flat bright daylight.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, runs the same hill road at an easy pace with his hands loose and his face settled. Middle distance: one drain cover, a roadside fence post, tussocks. Background: white cloud over the city and the harbour below, bright afternoon light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy running singlet soaked through and grey shorts, runs uphill with his shoulders dropped and his stride lengthening. Middle distance: one white marker post, the tussock bank, a gravel shoulder. Background: a grey road and blue sky over the far tops, hard clear light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet, sits on a low wall at the top of the hill writing in one spiral notebook on his knees. Middle distance: his sports watch, a stub of pencil. Background: the city in sun below and snow on the far peaks, bright afternoon light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a white school shirt, sits at a kitchen table with one hand flat on a closed training log, saying nothing. Middle distance: a plate of toast, a school bag by the door, a mug. Background: a window over the sink and bench, warm low evening light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, runs a flat park path beside a low wire fence with his head down. Middle distance: one marker post, a bin at the path edge, wet grass. Background: open wide grass and flat low trees, bright grey overcast light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, stands at the bottom car park holding one folded sheet of paper while the wind pushes at him. Middle distance: a start mark on the road, his sports watch. Background: the grey road climbing to the tops, bright windy sky.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, runs the hairpin bend with his head down and his jaw set, the wind at his vest. Middle distance: one white marker post, the tussock bank, a gravel run-off. Background: the road switching back up the hill, bright windy light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a navy singlet and grey shorts, crests the top of the hill road and looks down at one sports watch on his wrist. Middle distance: a marker post, the road dropping away. Background: the city in sun below and snow on the far peaks, clear afternoon light.

Coach Ria Tahiwi, a stocky woman in a black puffer jacket with a whistle on a lanyard, holds one training log turned around on a fence rail. Middle distance: a pencil, a stopwatch in her palm, a folded towel. Background: a wet road and grey hills, flat windy light overhead.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, pulls one navy running vest on over his bare chest beside the bottom car park, still breathing hard. Middle distance: a wheelbarrow of kit, a marker post, a water bottle, a bag of spikes. Background: the road going up the hill, bright windy afternoon light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a white school shirt, rides one bicycle away from a white marker post with his head down into the descent. Middle distance: a corner marker post, the verge, a road sign, tussocks. Background: the road falling away to the city and harbour, clear afternoon light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a white school shirt, sits at a desk writing in one training log with one pencil, the columns ruled by his own hand. Middle distance: a ruler, a sports watch, a mug. Background: a bedroom wall, a plain door and a curtained window, evening lamp light.

Hemi, thirteen, short dark hair, a white school shirt, holds one training log open in both hands, looking down at the two entries in the same column. Middle distance: a pencil, a mug, a plate. Background: a kitchen table and a window at dusk, low warm light on the bench behind.
